question:
A strategic bomber squadron has been ordered to destroy enemy military targets. It is known that there are four key areas, and destroying any one of them will achieve the objective. To complete this mission, the limits are set at $48000 \mathrm{~L}$ of gasoline, 48 heavy bombs, and 32 light bombs. When the aircraft carries heavy bombs, it can fly $2 \mathrm{~km}$ per liter of gasoline, and when it carries light bombs, it can fly $3 \mathrm{~km}$ per liter of gasoline. It is also known that each aircraft can only carry one bomb at a time, and each bombing mission consumes gasoline for the round trip (when empty, it can fly $4 \mathrm{~km}$ per liter of gasoline), as well as $100 \mathrm{~L}$ for takeoff and landing each time. The relevant data is shown in Table 1-17.

Table 1-17
\begin{tabular}{c|c|c|c}
\hline \multirow{2}{*}{ Key Area } & \multirow{2}{*}{ Distance from Base $/ \mathrm{km}$} & \multicolumn{2}{|c}{ Probability of Destruction } \\
\cline { 3 - 4 } & 450 & Per Heavy Bomb & Per Light Bomb \\
\hline 1 & 480 & 0.10 & 0.08 \\
2 & 540 & 0.20 & 0.16 \\
3 & 600 & 0.15 & 0.12 \\
4 & 0.25 & 0.20 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

To maximize the probability of destroying enemy military targets, how should the bombing plan be determined? Establish a linear programming model for this problem.

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "AREAS": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "BOMBS": ["H", "L"],
    "distance": {1: 480, 2: 540, 3: 600, 4: 450},
    "prob": {
        (1, "H"): 0.10, (1, "L"): 0.08,
        (2, "H"): 0.20, (2, "L"): 0.16,
        (3, "H"): 0.15, (3, "L"): 0.12,
        (4, "H"): 0.25, (4, "L"): 0.20,
    },
    "heavy_available": 48,
    "light_available": 32,
    "fuel_limit": 48000,
    "km_per_l_heavy": 2,
    "km_per_l_light": 3,
    "km_per_l_empty": 4,
    "overhead_per_trip": 200,   # 100 L takeoff + 100 L landing
    "big_M": 1000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.AREAS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["AREAS"])
    m.BOMBS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["BOMBS"])

    # x[a,b]: number of bombs of type b dropped on area a
    m.x = pyo.Var(m.AREAS, m.BOMBS, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # trip[a,b]: number of sorties to area a carrying bomb type b
    m.trip = pyo.Var(m.AREAS, m.BOMBS, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # z[a]: 1 if area a is attacked (destroyed)
    m.z = pyo.Var(m.AREAS, within=pyo.Binary)

    # Objective: maximise total destruction probability
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["prob"][(a, b)] * m.x[a, b] for a in m.AREAS for b in m.BOMBS)
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Each sortie carries exactly one bomb
    def link_rule(m, a, b):
        return m.x[a, b] == m.trip[a, b]
    m.link = pyo.Constraint(m.AREAS, m.BOMBS, rule=link_rule)

    # Heavy bomb availability
    def heavy_rule(m):
        return sum(m.x[a, "H"] for a in m.AREAS) <= d["heavy_available"]
    m.heavy_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=heavy_rule)

    # Light bomb availability
    def light_rule(m):
        return sum(m.x[a, "L"] for a in m.AREAS) <= d["light_available"]
    m.light_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=light_rule)

    # Gasoline budget
    def fuel_rule(m):
        heavy_fuel = sum(
            m.trip[a, "H"] * (2 * d["distance"][a] / d["km_per_l_heavy"] + d["overhead_per_trip"])
            for a in m.AREAS
        )
        light_fuel = sum(
            m.trip[a, "L"] * (2 * d["distance"][a] / d["km_per_l_light"] + d["overhead_per_trip"])
            for a in m.AREAS
        )
        return heavy_fuel + light_fuel <= d["fuel_limit"]
    m.fuel_budget = pyo.Constraint(rule=fuel_rule)

    # Area destruction logic: if any bomb dropped on a, then z[a] = 1
    def destroy_rule(m, a):
        return m.x[a, "H"] + m.x[a, "L"] <= d["big_M"] * m.z[a]
    m.destroy_logic = pyo.Constraint(m.AREAS, rule=destroy_rule)

    return m

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "areas": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "distance": {1: 450, 2: 480, 3: 540, 4: 600},
    "p_heavy": {1: 0.10, 2: 0.20, 3: 0.15, 4: 0.25},
    "p_light": {1: 0.08, 2: 0.16, 3: 0.12, 4: 0.20},
    "gasoline_limit": 48000.0,      # L
    "heavy_bomb_limit": 48,         # number of heavy bombs
    "light_bomb_limit": 32,         # number of light bombs
    "km_per_l_heavy": 2.0,          # heavy-bomb sortie fuel economy
    "km_per_l_light": 3.0,          # light-bomb sortie fuel economy
    "km_per_l_empty": 4.0,          # empty-leg (return) fuel economy
    "takeoff_landing_l": 100.0,     # L per sortie for takeoff + landing
    # number of enemies roughly needed for a confident hit (linear coverage)
    "hit_target": 0.90,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["areas"], ordered=True)

    # xH: number of heavy-bomb sorties against area i
    model.xH = pyo.Var(model.A, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    # xL: number of light-bomb sorties against area i
    model.xL = pyo.Var(model.A, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    # y: 0/1 selection indicating area i receives bombing effort
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.A, domain=pyo.Binary)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: maximize total expected destruction contribution
    #          = sum_i ( p_heavy(i)*xH_i + p_light(i)*xL_i )
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(
            d["p_heavy"][i] * m.xH[i] + d["p_light"][i] * m.xL[i]
            for i in m.A
        )
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint: heavy-bomb limit  ( "48 heavy bombs" )
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def heavy_bomb_limit_rule(m):
        return sum(m.xH[i] for i in m.A) <= d["heavy_bomb_limit"]
    model.heavy_bomb_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=heavy_bomb_limit_rule)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint: light-bomb limit  ( "32 light bombs" )
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def light_bomb_limit_rule(m):
        return sum(m.xL[i] for i in m.A) <= d["light_bomb_limit"]
    model.light_bomb_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=light_bomb_limit_rule)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint per area: gasoline consumed by all sorties to area i.
    # Round trip = distance out (loaded at economy) + distance back (empty)
    #             + takeoff/landing reserves.
    #   fuel_per_heavy_i = dist_i/km_per_l_heavy + dist_i/km_per_l_empty
    #                      + takeoff_landing_l
    #   fuel_per_light_i = dist_i/km_per_l_light + dist_i/km_per_l_empty
    #                      + takeoff_landing_l
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def fuel_per_heavy(i):
        return (d["distance"][i] / d["km_per_l_heavy"]
                + d["distance"][i] / d["km_per_l_empty"]
                + d["takeoff_landing_l"])

    def fuel_per_light(i):
        return (d["distance"][i] / d["km_per_l_light"]
                + d["distance"][i] / d["km_per_l_empty"]
                + d["takeoff_landing_l"])

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gasoline limit: 48000 L
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def gasoline_limit_rule(m):
        return sum(
            fuel_per_heavy(i) * m.xH[i] + fuel_per_light(i) * m.xL[i]
            for i in m.A
        ) <= d["gasoline_limit"]
    model.gasoline_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=gasoline_limit_rule)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Each area is either "engaged" or not: bounded integer sorties.
    # Using big-M so that y[i]=0 forces zero sorties, y[i]=1 allows any.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    bigM = d["heavy_bomb_limit"] + d["light_bomb_limit"]

    def engage_heavy_rule(m, i):
        return m.xH[i] <= bigM * m.y[i]
    model.engage_heavy = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=engage_heavy_rule)

    def engage_light_rule(m, i):
        return m.xL[i] <= bigM * m.y[i]
    model.engage_light = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=engage_light_rule)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # "Destroying any one area achieves the objective":
    # require at least one area be engaged (y summed >= 1).
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def at_least_one_area_rule(m):
        return sum(m.y[i] for i in m.A) >= 1
    model.at_least_one_area = pyo.Constraint(rule=at_least_one_area_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=d["areas"])
    model.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["bomb_types"])

    # x[i,b] = number of bombs of type b dropped on area i
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.I, model.B, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # y[i] = 1 if area i is destroyed (at least one successful bomb)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.I, within=pyo.Binary)

    # Objective: maximize total expected destruction probability
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(
            d["prob_heavy"][i] * m.x[i, "H"] * 0  # placeholder to keep linear
            for i in m.I
        )
    # Build objective explicitly linear: sum of p_i * y_i
    def obj_expr(m):
        total = 0
        for i in m.I:
            total += d["prob_heavy"][i] * m.x[i, "H"] * 0
        return total
    # Simpler: use y-variables weighted by max per-bomb probability
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=sum(
            (d["prob_heavy"][i] if d["prob_heavy"][i] >= d["prob_light"][i]
             else d["prob_light"][i]) * model.y[i]
            for i in model.I
        ),
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # Fuel consumption coefficient per mission to area i with bomb type b
    def fuel_coeff(i, b):
        dist = d["distance"][i]
        if b == "H":
            loaded_rate = d["km_per_liter_heavy"]
        else:
            loaded_rate = d["km_per_liter_light"]
        return dist / loaded_rate + dist / d["km_per_liter_empty"] + d["takeoff_landing_fuel"]

    # Gasoline budget constraint
    def gasoline_rule(m):
        return sum(
            fuel_coeff(i, b) * m.x[i, b] for i in m.I for b in m.B
        ) <= d["gasoline_budget"]
    model.gasoline = pyo.Constraint(rule=gasoline_rule)

    # Heavy bombs availability

        return sum(m.x[i, "H"] for i in m.I) <= d["heavy_bombs_available"]
    model.heavy_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=heavy_rule)

        return sum(m.x[i, "L"] for i in m.I) <= d["light_bombs_available"]
    model.light_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=light_rule)

    # Linking: area i can only be credited as destroyed if at least one bomb is sent
    def link_rule(m, i):
        return m.y[i] <= sum(m.x[i, b] for b in m.B)
    model.link = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=link_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.I = pyo.Set(initialize=d["areas"])
    m.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["bomb_types"])

    m.x = pyo.Var(m.I, m.B, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    m.y = pyo.Var(m.I, within=pyo.Binary)
    m.z = pyo.Var(m.B, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    def fuel_per_bomb(i, b):
        dist = d["distance"][i]
        loaded = dist / d["km_per_L_loaded"][b]
        empty = dist / d["km_per_L_empty"]
        return loaded + empty + 2 * d["fuel_takeoff_landing"]

    m.fuel = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=sum(fuel_per_bomb(i, b) * m.x[i, b] for i in m.I for b in m.B)
        <= d["gas_limit"]
    )

    def heavy_total_rule(mm):
        return sum(mm.x[i, "H"] for i in mm.I) <= d["heavy_avail"]
    m.heavy_total = pyo.Constraint(rule=heavy_total_rule)

    m.light_total = pyo.Constraint(rule=light_total_rule)

    def link_rule(mm, i):
        return mm.y[i] <= sum(mm.x[i, b] for b in mm.B) / d["bigM"] * d["bigM"] / 1
    m.link = pyo.Constraint(m.I, rule=link_rule)

    def link_rule_exact(mm, i):
        return mm.y[i] <= sum(mm.x[i, b] for b in mm.B)
    m.link_exact = pyo.Constraint(m.I, rule=link_rule_exact)

    def prob_expr(mm):
        return sum(d["p_destroy"][(b, i)] * mm.x[i, b] for i in mm.I for b in mm.B)
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=prob_expr(m), sense=pyo.maximize)

    return m

            d["p_heavy"][i] * m.h[i] + d["p_light"][i] * m.l[i]
            for i in m.T
        )
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

"""
Strategic bomber mission planning.

Decision variables (index sets: areas A = {1,2,3,4}, bomb types B = {H, L}):
  n[a,b] : INTEGER number of bombs of type b delivered to area a.  Domain: NonNegativeIntegers.
  y[a]   : BINARY, 1 if area a is attacked (at least one bomb delivered).  Domain: Binary.

Objective (maximize): total expected destruction, modelled as the sum over areas of the
  per-bomb destruction probabilities times the number of bombs delivered to that area
  (additive/linear surrogate for the probability of destroying the target).

Constraints:
  (1) Gasoline limit: total fuel consumed by all sorties <= 48000 L.
      Fuel per sortie to area a with bomb type b = 100 (takeoff) + 100 (landing)
        + distance(a)/2 (outbound, heavy) or distance(a)/3 (outbound, light)
        + distance(a)/4 (return, empty).
  (2) Heavy bomb limit: total heavy bombs delivered <= 48.
  (3) Light bomb limit: total light bombs delivered <= 32.
  (4) Linking: n[a,b] <= M * y[a]  (big-M), so y[a] = 1 whenever any bomb goes to area a.
  (5) Each aircraft carries only one bomb at a time (implicit in per-bomb accounting).
"""

DATA = {

    },
    "gasoline_limit": 48000,

    "light_limit": 32,
    "takeoff_landing_fuel": 100,
    "km_per_liter_heavy": 2,
    "km_per_liter_light": 3,
    "km_per_liter_empty": 4,
    "big_m": 1000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["areas"])
    model.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["bomb_types"])

    model.n = pyo.Var(model.A, model.B, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.Binary)

    def fuel_per_sortie(a, b):
        dist = d["distance"][a]
        if b == "H":
            outbound = dist / d["km_per_liter_heavy"]
        else:
            outbound = dist / d["km_per_liter_light"]
        inbound = dist / d["km_per_liter_empty"]
        return d["takeoff_landing_fuel"] + outbound + inbound

    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["prob"][(b, a)] * m.n[a, b] for a in m.A for b in m.B)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    def gasoline_rule(m):
        return sum(fuel_per_sortie(a, b) * m.n[a, b]
                   for a in m.A for b in m.B) <= d["gasoline_limit"]

    model.gasoline = pyo.Constraint(rule=gasoline_rule)

    def heavy_rule(m):
        return sum(m.n[a, "H"] for a in m.A) <= d["heavy_limit"]

    model.heavy = pyo.Constraint(rule=heavy_rule)

    def light_rule(m):
        return sum(m.n[a, "L"] for a in m.A) <= d["light_limit"]

    model.light = pyo.Constraint(rule=light_rule)

    def link_rule(m, a, b):
        return m.n[a, b] <= d["big_m"] * m.y[a]

    model.link = pyo.Constraint(model.A, model.B, rule=link_rule)

    return model
